title: GZCL General Gainz
author: Solomon Sands
desc:
GZCL General Gainz Template. Based on the gzcl post by Cody Lefever
Intro:
https://www.reddit.com/r/gzcl/s/HoHUYrNzbG
Expanded:
https://swoleateveryheight.blogspot.com/2019/10/200-days.html?m=1

ex.note: Start with 3 warmup sets of 3-5 reps. Pick a weight to attempt a 3-6 Rep Max attempt.
Using the same weight as the 3-6RM, perform the same number of sets of singles. Ex: 4RM = 4 sets of 1. If RPE of last set is 7 or less, add up to an additional 3 sets.
Start with 3 warmup sets of 3-5 reps. Pick a weight to attempt a 6-10 Rep Max attempt.

Using the same weight as the 6-10RM, perform half number of RM as sets for a total volume of double the RM. Ex: 8RM = 4 sets of 4 reps. If RPE of last set is 7 or less, add up to an additional 2 sets.
